M5 Pro MacBook Pro 24GB down $500, 48GB model down $400, more deals

In addition to the ongoing July Black Friday deals on AirPods Pro 3 with $50 off, and $100 off Apple AirPods Max 2 in all colors, the latest M5 MacBook Pro lineup pricing has also seen a notable drop. Highlights include: the 14-inch 24GB/2TB M5 Pro model from Amazon, $500 off list price; as well as a 48GB model from B&H, $400 off list.

It's not an exaggeration to say this is the best M5 Pro MacBook Pro deal we've seen since the price hike began. Amazon has the 14-inch M5 Pro MacBook Pro down to $2,499 with free shipping. Originally $2,999, this $500 markdown comes with 24GB of RAM and 2TB of built-in storage, $500 off the new pricing.

This deal is particularly attractive because Apple recently just hiked this configuration by $400, and even before the price hike, Amazon never dipped below $2,340.

Another highlight of this week's MacBook Pro deals is the 14-inch 48GB/1TB M5 Pro model from B&H, going for as low as $2,799 with free shipping. This one is of course more expensive, but with double the RAM and $400 off the $3,199 list price, you simply can't get this configuration from Amazon.

Twelve South's PlugBug wall charger with built-in Find My drops to new Amazon low of $40

The Twelve South PlugBug 50W USB-C charger with built-in Apple Find My is now down to $40 on Amazon, nearly 55% off the original price.

Amazon has the Twelve South PlugBug 50W USB-C wall charger down to $39.99 with free shipping.

This product originally launched at $70, later adjusted to Twelve South's official MSRP of $50. For most of this year, the Amazon price has hovered around $55, but it's now dropped to a new 2026 low. During Prime Day this year, it briefly dipped to just over $40.

Beyond its unique and minimalist aesthetic design, this is essentially a practical EDC and travel essential — offering a slim wall charger with two USB-C ports on the bottom that can charge your devices anywhere there's an outlet.

The plug prongs fold away for easy portability, with a maximum output of 50W, but the standout feature is the built-in Apple Find My functionality. Like other third-party Find My accessories, it pairs quickly with the Find My app, providing standard location and left-behind notifications — for a charger, especially one that's frequently carried in and out for travel or EDC bags, this feature is particularly reassuring.

For an in-depth look at features and user experience, check out my hands-on review of the Twelve South PlugBug.

Grab the July Black Friday Apple Watch Series 11 deal, starting from $299, while supplies last ($100 off)

There's still a long time left in summer, and if you're looking to pick up a new Apple wearable, the most popular Series 11 models are $100 off list price — time to act.

Over the past week we've seen plenty of special deals on higher-end Apple Watch Series 11 configurations, but if you're looking for the most affordable and arguably best value model, I think the $100 off the base version is the top pick:

  • 42mm Apple Watch Series 11 $299 (originally $399)
  • 46mm Apple Watch Series 11 $329 (originally $429)

As of this morning's deadline, Amazon's base aluminum 42mm and 46mm Series 11 models still have the $100 discount. However, some case colors for the larger 46mm model are starting to show stockouts, so it's best to keep an eye on the situation and grab one before prices rebound.

These deals are largely in line with the best prices we've seen since launch, second only to certain configurations during June Prime Day that were $20 cheaper than current pricing. But as July Black Friday deals wind down this weekend, discounts on these Apple Watch Series 11 models may also adjust — and in fact, that's already starting to happen.
